title: Paper Towel Holder Wall Mount 15.5-Inch | Matte White | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Clear your countertop and keep a roll right where you need it in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy kitchens atmosphere. This wall-mounted paper towel holder (also called a paper towel rack or paper towel holder wall mount) brings an industrial pipe-fitting look to a transitional kitchen while coordinating with the Brass Paper Towel Holders collection.

Highlights:
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Easy-to-coordinate style—Pipeline-inspired design blends with modern and traditional decor for versatile accessories
- Cleaner-looking finish—protected with a highly durable powder coat
- Built for everyday use—materials resist corrosion and rust for continual service
- Confident install—mounts firmly with color coordinated screws and included mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Paper towel holder / paper towel rack
- Mounting: Wall mount (wall-mounted)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3 x 4 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 6 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 1.3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
19 designer finish options available
